name: Human Evolution
description: Seven million years from the first upright apes to Homo sapiens: Lucy, Homo erectus, the Neanderthals and us.

checkpoints.name: The first upright apes
checkpoints.note: The oldest ancestors, such as Sahelanthropus and Ardipithecus, begin to walk upright while still climbing in trees.

checkpoints.name: Australopithecus and the first tools
checkpoints.note: Australopithecines such as Lucy walk the African savanna, leaving footprints at Laetoli, and the first stone tools appear.

checkpoints.name: The first humans
checkpoints.note: Homo habilis and Homo erectus make better tools, tame fire and spread out of Africa across Asia and Europe.

checkpoints.name: Many kinds of human
checkpoints.note: Homo sapiens, Neanderthals, Denisovans, Homo naledi and the hobbit of Flores share the world, and only our species survives.

checkpoints.name: Homo sapiens alone
checkpoints.note: The last other humans disappear and only Homo sapiens remains. Painters decorate caves such as Lascaux, and people cross the land bridge of Beringia into the Americas.
